verdict.rationale: Daytona exposes a published OpenAPI spec, official Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. Its core features are documented as programmatically manageable: sandbox lifecycle, snapshots and warm pools, volumes, network firewall updates on running sandboxes, code execution and computer use. Browser-terminal workflows have programmatic equivalents through SSH and process exec. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that the API matches the UI/dashboard, coverage of dashboard-only or account/org/billing functions via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
